semantics.bootstrap: Explicit state root owns a retained parent. Missing fixed child reserves81MiB+6 names before mkdir; the zero-length control lock may already exist on refusal. Existing DB/WAL/rollback/SHM are charged by the shared inventory and only remaining peak growth/missing names are reserved. Unknown ordinary files count; no record eviction or permission repair
semantics.legacy: AuditStore::open does not infer a global root from arbitrary parent paths. save_plan_manifest requires explicit state binding. Unsupported audit platforms stay unsupported
semantics.ownership: ShortStoreLock owns strong Arc<StateWriteSession>; Root stores Weak, SQL pins a strong lease through C close/VFS teardown. Component file closes before global lease release. Claimed operations/observer intervals retain exclusion. State control binding and issuing PID validated before/after SQL
semantics.restoration: Live claims still publish only after successful protected SQL close/restoration. Refused publication cannot reenter the mutation mutex via a claim Drop. Recovery fence2 remains possible; state exclusion releases after refusal
semantics.plans: Borrowed typed Manifest with stable camelCase fields and unchanged canonical plan digest; compact JSON; at most8MiB encoded with shared writer, no extra Value tree. One temporary/final additional name. Native RENAME_NOREPLACE/RENAME_EXCL, no overwrite fallback. Precommit encoding/restoration refusal removes only owned temp. Postcommit sync failure may retain the new record
semantics.linuxConsumer: Real bounded Permanent CLI prepare_audit uses the explicit state API and native manifest writer; removes display-path creator and redundant operation-store preparation. Admission refusal precedes target submission; no claim that all later errors leave a target untouched
semantics.independentOracles: ordinary metadata/bytes/serde decode and separate FD kernel flock; literal byte/name boundaries, competing destination through serializer mutation, actual after-C-close hook. Fixtures use existing canonical private child; production privacy unchanged
semantics.noncooperating: Control substitution is refused when observed. Long claims do not re-enumerate arbitrary external changes; no global cap against actors ignoring the lock, atomic check-and-unlink or ABA proof
semantics.serializeBounds: Encoded stream and writer buffer bounded, not arbitrary custom Serialize CPU/heap/stack. CLI uses a fixed borrowed typed shape
semantics.nativeQualification: macOS race/policy tests executed; new Linux CLI cases and renameat2 only compiled, not run. No native Linux/Windows/MSVC/provider/Trash qualification
semantics.changesAfterTests: Only unsupported Windows branch cfg gates and publication comment clarification changed after host suites; Unix behavior and Linux test contents unchanged
